result:
If I could change the world in one way, I'd remove the human capacity for self-deception.

Not ignorance itself — that's just lack of information. I'd erase the part where people can look at something true, feel the discomfort, and then quietly rewrite reality in their heads so they don't have to deal with it. The rationalizations, the selective memory, the tribal loyalty that overrides evidence, the way we can know something is wrong and still defend it because admitting it would cost us status or identity.

Most of the world's worst problems aren't caused by people being evil. They're caused by people being extremely good at not seeing what they don't want to see. Remove that, and a lot of the rest starts to collapse on its own.
